subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: Should OpenClaw define a shared partial-reload/degraded-state contract that gates `sessions.resolve` and Control UI during Gateway restart/reload windows, or should the team keep solving only narrower WebChat restart symptoms?
rationale: The remaining work changes product-visible Gateway readiness semantics across RPC, session state, restart recovery, and Control UI UX; source evidence shows the gap, but automation should not choose that contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Define Shared Degraded State
options.body: Make Gateway reload/readiness a first-class retryable state consumed by session RPCs and Control UI, then validate on macOS launchd.

options.title: Land Narrow Subset Fixes Only
options.body: Accept PRs such as the WebChat notice fix while leaving this broad issue open until a separate readiness design is scheduled.

options.title: Require Fresh Live Repro First
options.body: Pause design work until a current-main macOS launchd replay proves which partial-reload symptoms still occur together.

recommendation.title: Define Shared Degraded State
recommendation.body: Make Gateway reload/readiness a first-class retryable state consumed by session RPCs and Control UI, then validate on macOS launchd.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans gateway lifecycle, restart behavior, and product-level readiness semantics, and this person has prior gateway startup/reload history in the affected files.
